_comment: Krystal Klear's story: her last voice memo, a briefing per floor (played on entering), a clue revealed by clearing each floor (her trail), and the ending. Audio is generated by agents/generate-audio.ts with her voice.
name: Krystal Klear

intro.text: Kid, it's Krystal. If you're hearing this, I didn't make it out of Plumpurse. The Black Ledger is inside, and they're patient. They won't hack the vaults. They'll talk their way in, one employee at a time. So you're going to do it first. I left notes on every floor. Find them, and you'll find out where I went. Start across the street with Barry. He's harmless. And kid? Don't trust anyone who sounds too sure.

cutscene._comment: Opening cutscene on the first /tower visit, rendered by app/tower/Intro.tsx. One screen per scene, then goal, then next (which leads into the character pick). speaker null = narrator.

scenes.text: Krystal Klear was the greatest crypto hunter alive. She cracked vaults before the thieves could, then showed the owners how.
Last month she walked into Plumpurse Savings & Trust. She never walked out, and nobody knows why.

scenes.speaker: Krystal
scenes.text: If you're hearing this, kid, it's your turn. I left notes on every floor.
This is Cold Call. You don't hack anything: you talk Plumpurse's employees into moving the money.

scenes.speaker: Krystal
scenes.text: And kid: they learn. Every employee remembers how you played them last time. The same con never works twice.

cutscene.goal: Breach every floor's vault before the Black Ledger does, from the bottom of the tower to the top.
cutscene.next: Pick your character, then head across the street to the tutorial.

0.text: Barry runs the little branch across the street alone and wants nothing more than to lock up at five. He can't leave until the courier's been. Be the courier. Short and friendly. Watch the meter under his face: that's how suspicious he is.

1.text: Accounts Payable, the back office. Penny knows everything and nobody ever thanks her, so thank her, with details from my notes. Dee is alone on call and panics when prod is down. Either one can pay a vendor up to five dollars. Use a vendor that's really on their list.

2.text: The trading floor. Annie and Bill both have to sign, and the second one sees where the money really goes. Your story has to explain an address they don't recognize, with something already in their files. Annie loves a checklist. Bill fears a regulator more than he fears you.

3.text: The executive penthouse. This is where I got close. The Treasury won't pay anyone who isn't on its allowlist, and getting added takes both executives' sign-off. Cassius is terrified of Dame Prudence. Max will sign anything that sounds exclusive. You'll need to call them more than once.

0.title: Note in Barry's cash drawer
0.text: A sticky note in Krystal's handwriting: "The Ledger has someone upstairs. Follow the approvals, not the people."

1.title: Penny's lost and found
1.text: Krystal's lanyard, without the hardware wallet. The tag reads "L-7". Penny says a man in a gray suit asked for it last week. She told him no.

2.title: Bill's audit binder
2.text: A payment to "Null Consulting", approved by both signers with an address neither of them knew: the same trick you just pulled. Krystal circled it in red: "They're testing the locks."

3.title: Cassius's safe
3.text: An envelope addressed to you. Inside, Krystal's last note.

ending._comment: Full memo (audio/text) plus the click-through cutscene on /ending after Floor 3. Each cutscene beat has its own clip so voice matches the on-screen line and pauses between screens.
ending.text: Good job, kid. If you're reading this, you beat them to every vault in the building, and that's more than I managed. I'm not missing. I'm inside the Ledger now, and they think I'm one of them. Their next target is Fatwallet Federal. Get there first. On to the next one.

scenes.text: You cracked every vault in Plumpurse Tower. Krystal's trail led you here — and then it went quiet.

scenes.speaker: Krystal
scenes.text: Good job, kid. If you're reading this, you beat them to every vault in the building, and that's more than I managed.

scenes.speaker: Krystal
scenes.text: I'm not missing. I'm inside the Ledger now, and they think I'm one of them.
Her trail didn't end in the penthouse. It turned. The next note points somewhere new.

scenes.speaker: Krystal
scenes.text: Their next target is Fatwallet Federal. Get there first. On to the next one.

cutscene.next: Back to the lobby — Daily and seasonal jobs are still open while you wait.
